purpose: Native UI composition and Q36/Q37 disclosure groups. Read-only Planner data; local presentation preferences persist.

commands.phone: env DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild -project Planner.xcodeproj -scheme PlannerNavigation -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 18 Pro' -derivedDataPath /private/tmp/PlannerNavigationNativeRevision -onlyUsePackageVersionsFromResolvedFile -clonedSourcePackagesDirPath /private/tmp/PlannerMCPSourcePackages -parallel-testing-enabled NO -resultBundlePath /private/tmp/PlannerNavigationNativePhoneComplete.xcresult test
commands.tablet: env DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild -project Planner.xcodeproj -scheme PlannerNavigation -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPad Air 11-inch (M4)' -derivedDataPath /private/tmp/PlannerNavigationNativeTabletRevision -onlyUsePackageVersionsFromResolvedFile -clonedSourcePackagesDirPath /private/tmp/PlannerMCPSourcePackages -parallel-testing-enabled NO -resultBundlePath /private/tmp/PlannerNavigationNativeTabletComplete.xcresult test
commands.mac: env DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild -project Planner.xcodeproj -scheme PlannerNavigation -destination 'platform=macOS,arch=arm64' -derivedDataPath /private/tmp/PlannerNavigationNativeMacRevision -onlyUsePackageVersionsFromResolvedFile -clonedSourcePackagesDirPath /private/tmp/PlannerMCPSourcePackages -parallel-testing-enabled NO -test-timeouts-enabled YES -default-test-execution-time-allowance 90 -maximum-test-execution-time-allowance 90 -resultBundlePath /private/tmp/PlannerNavigationNativeMacComplete.xcresult test
